extends: scripts/w2r1/prereg.json (unchanged; sha256 at the time of this file is recorded in FROZEN.json at S7)
declared_before: any K/D-ST model fit, any VAL scoring, any look at 2026 weeks 1-5 outcomes. This file only FIXES design constants that prereg.json left to the implementation; it loosens no threshold, changes no label and no split.
regimes: scripts/w2r1/s4_regimes.json (exact K/D-ST scoring of the five registered leagues). A model is evaluated and labelled PER REGIME; regimes are never pooled. A regime whose non-zero scoring keys include a component this spec cannot reconstruct is labelled DIAGNOSTIC_UNQUALIFIED for that component (reported, not qualified).

unit.K: team-game: the team's kicker slot (identity as of the previous game; kicker-change rows are flagged and kept)

population.K: team has >= 1 FG attempt in its prior 3 games (prereg relevance floor)
population.weeks: regular season weeks >= 3 for FIT/VAL targets (weeks 1-2 use prior-season evidence only and are reported separately)

components.points_allowed_reconstruction: points scored by the opponent while ON OFFENSE (TD 6, FG 3, XP 1, 2pt 2 on opponent-offense plays). Non-offensive points (defensive / special-teams TDs, safeties) are NOT points allowed by the defense. Approximation: a provider may differ on rare plays; documented limitation.

as_of_rates.team_rate_per_game: (sum of the team's component over its previous up to 10 games, crossing the season boundary with the same weight, + k0 * league_mean_per_game) / (n_games + k0), k0 = 4. League mean is the FIT mean (fixed artifact).
as_of_rates.kicker_make_probability: league logistic p_L(distance bin, wind>=15, dome, temp<40) fitted on FIT FG attempts; kicker multiplier ratio = (makes_k + m_k) / (sum of p_L over his prior attempts + m_k), m_k = 15, odds-scaled and clipped to [0.5, 1.5]; kicker identity = the team's last kicker; a new kicker uses ratio 1.
as_of_rates.distance_shares: (team_att_b + m_s * league_share_b) / (team_att + m_s), m_s = 20 attempts over the team's previous up to 10 games

models.count_models: Poisson GLM (log link), fit on FIT only, one per count component, with the fixed feature lists below; no hyper-parameter search (nothing to choose on VAL except the pre-declared feature lists A/B listed here).
models.DST_rare_components: defensive_tds, special_teams_tds, safeties, blocked_kicks, defensive_2pt, forced_fumbles, fourth_down_stops, forced_punts: team rate shrunk to league (k0 = 4) with NO regression (too sparse to regress); yard components = expected count x FIT mean yards per event.
models.points_allowed: negative-binomial distribution of opponent-offense points with mean = linear function of [implied_opp_total, opp_ppg_rate, def_pa_rate] fitted on FIT, dispersion fitted on FIT; expected score under any regime computed from the distribution (continuous per-point keys use the mean).
models.feature_set_choice: A vs B chosen per component on VAL log-likelihood (the only VAL-selected choice); ties -> A
models.expected_points: exact: sum over components of E[count] x regime weight, with bin-wise FG make/miss weights and the full points-allowed distribution; spike: Monte-Carlo (n = 4000, seed 20261014) of the component joint (independent Poisson counts, binomial makes) against the regime's FIT cut

controls.K_control: prior-4-game mean of the team's K points under the regime (prereg K_control)
controls.DST_control: prior-4-game mean of the team's D/ST points under the regime (prereg DST_control)
controls.note: the provider's generic 'standard points' fallback has no stored history, so it cannot be a historical control; it is the control in the LIVE preview only.

metrics: paired cluster bootstrap by game (B=2000, seed 20261014)
tier results by control forecast tercile

spike.label: weekly top-6 finish among the 32 team slots at the position under the regime (prereg PRIMARY)
spike.cut: FIT median of the weekly 6th-best score per regime (used only to turn a simulated score distribution into P(score >= cut))
spike.M1: logistic regression on [model expected points, model SD], C chosen from [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10] on VAL log loss

final_guard: no script in this stage may read or score 2026 weeks 1-5 outcomes; the harness refuses unless FROZEN.json exists (S7).
